thread:
sam: Heads-up — customer AcmePay seeing parser errors on structured=json. They get downstream parser failures after our response. Example returned payload had an extra "__rw_meta" key injected into one of the items in the results array, causing a schema mismatch.

sam: Repro steps:
1. curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-1","routing":"smart","input":"...","mode":"json"}'
2. Observe response payload (below)

sam:
```
{
  "request_id":"req_abc123",
  "results": [
    {"id":"1","score":0.98,"value":{"name":"Alice"}},
    {"id":"2","score":0.92,"value":{"name":"Bob"},"__rw_meta":"trace-0a1b"}
  ]
}
```

sam: Downstream JSON schema disallows additional keys inside results[*] and the consumer fails with parser error "Unexpected field '__rw_meta'". This started after yesterday's routing change and customer is P1 (production payments flow) — they reported failures in prod and are throttling traffic.

kai: Can you paste the request_id and full logs? Also which model variant got routed? :eyes: 

sam: request_id=req_abc123, route header shows X-Redwood-Route: smart -> fallback:gptj-compat-v2. I've attached the API debug log snippet: (truncated)
```
[2026-04-xx 10:05:21] req=req_abc123 route=smart(primary=redwood-chat-1 fallback=gptj-compat-v2) response_code=200 latency_ms=420
[2026-04-xx 10:05:21] req=req_abc123 fallback_selected=true variant=gptj-compat-v2 reason=capacity
```

jess: That fallback variant has a known debug hook that serializes internal trace metadata into outputs when model is quantized — shouldn't happen for mode=json. Repro locally? Try forcing `allow_fallback=false` or pin model to redwood-chat-1 and confirm.

sam: Repro steps attached — when I pin to redwood-chat-1 the extra key disappears. With smart routing enabled it appears ~1 in 20 responses returns the extra key.

toby: Escalating to eng-ml-oncall. Customer impact high. Support ticket #INC-2026-2745 created. :rotating_light: 

support-bot: Created INC-2026-2745 | Priority: P1 | Owner: eng-ml-oncall

eng-ml-oncall: Thanks — looking. Could you add the raw response (no pretty print) and the signed request id (X-Request-Id) from customer so we can cross-check across nodes? Also what's the exact structured flag name? Is it `mode: "json"` or `structured: "json"`?

sam: Downstream sends structured=JSON in query. Raw response (one-liner):
```
{"request_id":"req_abc123","results":[{"id":"1","score":0.98,"value":{"name":"Alice"}},{"id":"2","score":0.92,"value":{"name":"Bob"},"__rw_meta":"trace-0a1b"}]}
```

jess: Confirmed root cause: a debug postprocessor in gptj-compat-v2 appends `__rw_meta` to top-level objects in arrays to carry per-item tracing for asynchronous sharding. We never enabled that in JSON/structured mode. Preparing hotfix to strip any keys prefixed with `__rw_` when content-type is application/json OR when structured mode is set. Temporary mitigation: set routing policy env `RW_ROUTING_DISABLE_FALLBACK=true` for the customer's route, or pin model. I'll push patch and coordinate rollback window.

kai: How about a quick rule in the gateway: if Content-Type indicates structured=json, reject responses that mutate schema, or sanitize keys starting with `__rw_`. We can add a rate-limited rewrite to avoid downtime.

eng-ml-oncall: Agreed. Plan: (1) Gate at gateway to strip `__rw_` keys for structured responses (hotfix, 30m), (2) Deploy model variant patch to remove debug hook (2-4 hours), (3) Backfill fix to routing config to prevent fallback for structured-critical routes (tomorrow). Will update INC-2026-2745.

sam: Customer accepted temporary pin for the next 24h. They're also worried about billing — they saw errors and retry storms. Any billing impact? 

toby: Billing note: errors may have generated some billed tokens on retries; finance flagged for potential credits. cc @billing

jess: I'll add logging to detect any other `__rw_` occurrences across services and create an alert rule. Also we should add a test to our eval harness for structured=json with fallback simulation.

sam: Thanks all. I'll notify customer of mitigation (pin + temporary routing change) and update ticket.

eng-ml-oncall: Patch deployed to gateway in canary 2; sanitized responses for that route. Monitoring for 15m.

sam: Canary looks good; customer reports no new errors. Closing loop once full rollout is done.
